limitations.note: The default waveform matched, but the rewrite also changed counter sizing, mode selection, and pulse widths under parameter overrides; the bug only required changing the even-period shift from 3 to 2.

The default waveform check would catch the bug, but the override check expected the rewrite’s nine-cycle high pulse for a period of 18 rather than the six-cycle pulse from the unchanged odd-period comparison.
